articles.title: Cameroon Joins Global AI Body as Founding Member
articles.description: Cameroon, along with 28 other countries, signed the agreement establishing the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, WAICO, a new intergovernmental body aimed at strengthening international cooperation and global governance in artificial intelligence. The agreement was signed in Shanghai, China, ahead of the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference, held from July 17 to 20 under the theme: “ AI Partnerships for a Brighter Future .” The Minister of Minister of Posts and Telecommunications, Minette Libom Li Likeng, signed on behalf of the country. WAICO will be headquartered in Shanghai and run as an independent intergovernmental organization, tasked with promoting international cooperation and global governance in AI, according to details reported by China’s Xinhua news agency. Its stated goals include ensuring AI development is safe, fair and beneficial, upholding the core purposes of the UN Charter, and adopting a people-centred, consultative approach to shared technological gains. For Cameroon, membership carries direct economic weight. Speaking in Shanghai, Minister Libom Li Likeng linked the country’s participation to its national Artificial Intelligence Development Strategy, framing AI cooperation ...
